about: Round 661. Every fact the three hand typed trivia banks show a player (Hall of Fame or Bust, Guess the Year, Score Predictor), checked on 2026-09-28 against at least two sources on two different hosts, one of them the sport's governing body, league or hall of fame wherever that page would answer, and at least one that is not. scripts/simTriviaFacts.mjs holds the shipped files to this record word for word and fails if either side moves. Wikipedia and other wikis are never a source here. A fact that carries "noOfficial" stands on independent sources and says why the official page is missing. An entry marked "editorial" is a flavour line with no checkable claim (a Hall of Fame or Bust verdict label, a Score Predictor teaser hint) and says so. For Score Predictor, homeTeam is the side listed first: where one side really was at home it is that side, and "neutral" marks a final at a neutral ground, where the order is not a claim. Guess the Year uses the calendar year an event happened in, so a Super Bowl or bowl game played in January belongs to the new year.
